name: Blinding Flash
body:
Discipline: psychokinesis [light]; Level: Psion/wilder 0, psychic warrior 0, sighted seeker 1

MANIFESTING

Display: Visual
Manifesting Time: 1 swift action

EFFECT

Range: close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target: 1 creature
Duration: 1 round
Saving Throw: Fortitude Negates; Power Resistance: Yes
Power Points: Psionic focus or 1

DESCRIPTION

You create a blinding flash of light to momentarily distract an opponent. The target of this power must make a Fortitude save or be dazzled for one round.

Augment: You may augment this power in one or both of the following ways:

1. For every additional power point you spend, the power’s duration increases by one round.

2. If you spend 4 additional power points, the target is blinded instead of dazzled.

In addition, for every 2 power points spent to achieve either of these effects, increase the save DC by 1.
